name: voice-profile
description: Measure your writing voice from your own pre-AI writing and calls, score your Big Five with quoted evidence, and get a prompt plus a pass/fail verifier that holds AI to your voice.

interface.longDescription: Voice Profile measures how you write from your own pre-AI writing (and, optionally, your call transcripts). It scores ten features of your prose, finds your writing modes, scores your Big Five traits with quotes from your own words, and builds a prompt that makes AI write the way you do. A verifier then scores any draft against your profile and returns pass or fail per feature, so 'does this sound like me' stops being a vibe. Scripts are standard-library Python and make no network calls.
defaultPrompt: Build my voice profile from my old writing
Check whether this draft sounds like me
Rewrite this AI draft in my voice
